answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 36522 Country: India Title: Is hair dye (black) permissible to some one, whose age is 38 and his wife asks him to dye his hair? Please send me answer about this Question: Is hair dye (black) permissible to some one, whose age is 38 and his wife asks him to dye his hair? Please send me answer about this. Answer ID: 36522 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 213/119/H=1433) No, he cannot dye in this case too. It is makrooh tahrimi and unlawful in this condition also. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
